name: cashu-ts
description: cashU TypeScript monorepo: desktop and mobile apps, local host, CLI and MCP server.

scripts.test:emulator: command java -version >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'test:emulator: Java 21+ is missing (macOS: brew install openjdk and put its bin on PATH)' >&2; exit 1; }; ${CASHU_FIREBASE:-firebase} --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'test:emulator: firebase-tools is missing (npm install -g firebase-tools, or set CASHU_FIREBASE)' >&2; exit 1; }; ${CASHU_FIREBASE:-firebase} emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-cashu 'pnpm --filter @cashu/sync test:emulator && pnpm --filter @cashu/host test:emulator'
scripts.check: turbo run typecheck lint && pnpm test
scripts.check:handoff: pnpm check && pnpm test:exhaustive && pnpm arch:check
